title: St George's Cathedral bells (Cape Town)
status_note: Ring of ten for change ringing.

place.label: St George's Cathedral, Cape Town
place.coords_source: OpenStreetMap Nominatim lookup of the named site (ODbL)

mass_note: tenor 25-0-0 cwt, about 1,270 kg (Dove's Guide); ring about 300–1,300 kg (cathedral)

timeline.event: Cast as a chime for a car park (Dove's Guide)
Moved into the cathedral tower (Dove's Guide)

tiers.everyday: St George's Cathedral in Cape Town has a ring of ten bells for English-style change ringing, one of few in Africa.
tiers.student: The cathedral describes a ring of ten from about 300 kg to 1,300 kg. Dove's Guide (reference) gives a 1962 Mears & Stainbank casting first used as a chime, a move to the tower in 1979 and a 25 cwt tenor in E flat, 52 in across.

model.label: 3D uses the tenor (52 in, Dove's Guide). Parametric profile scaled from the sourced diameter; the curve itself is a generic Western bell profile, not a scan.
